metadata.name: Decisions (Jev)
metadata.summary: Typed decisions with calibrated confidence from Jev (TypeSafe AI)
metadata.description: Design extension backed by Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model. Ask choice, score or yes/no questions about some data and get probabilities and a confidence to route on. Ships the decide tool for an agentic worker and a Jev Decide node for plain flows. The API key is injected by the host from a secret reference and never returned. Outbound calls are restricted to api.typesafe.ai.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Ask Jev (TypeSafe AI) typed questions about some data and get choices, scores or yes/no probabilities with confidence. The API key is injected by the host and never returned.
